This confrontation commonly occurs in Act 2 if Astarion never confessed or if his feeding/bite attack was witnessed or exposed (for example during a camp-night bite or using his bite in front of others). Off‑screen, companions may already suspect or have discussed the attack, and Lae'zel offers a conditional truce: she will tolerate your presence only if you promise not to feed on anyone in the group, otherwise she threatens violent reprisal. The player can admit, deflect, or pledge restraint; prior events (a camp feeding attempt, woke victim, or other revelations) often explain why the accusation appears now.
